name: Realizable Ample Characterization Equivalence
statement: Affine-convex realizability together with ampleness, positivity of the separation margin, existence of a positive normalized minimal-pattern certificate, and nonemptiness of the separator coefficient space are equivalent.
proof: A positive certificate defines an open polyhedral cone by its strict separator inequalities; its orthants are exactly the concepts, and convex projection plus perturbation proves ampleness. Conversely, separate the convex image from every missing-pattern cylinder. Minimality makes every row coefficient positive, and ampleness makes every separator strict on the open domain. Finitely many witnesses then have a common positive slack; rational perturbation gives a positive rational certificate.
